resources.name: Crucial Music
resources.description: Non-exclusive sync agency with personalized service. 50/50 sync fee split; you keep 100% writer royalties. Must own masters and be registered with a PRO.

resources.name: Songtradr
resources.description: Global marketplace with AI-powered matching. Free tier gets 60% of sync fees; Pro tier gets 80%. Non-exclusive.

resources.name: Bodega Sync
resources.description: Division of Symphonic Distribution. Curated roster of indie artists/labels with 30+ years experience. Pre-cleared catalog for one-stop licensing.

resources.name: Artist Portal Studio
resources.description: Open-call platform for specific sync briefs. Submit music for consideration on TV, film, trailer, and commercial placements.

resources.name: Directional Music
resources.description: Flexible contracts with support for independent artists. Focus on indie films and digital content. Smaller catalog with hands-on approach.

resources.name: TAXI
resources.description: Established in 1992. Publishes screened music-wanted listings from supervisors, labels, ad agencies, and game companies. Screeners review and forward qualifying tracks.

resources.name: Music Gateway
resources.description: Partnerships with Disney, Netflix, Universal. 75–80% artist payout. You keep 100% backend royalties. Pitches to execs in London and LA.

resources.name: Broadjam
resources.description: Connects 110,000+ artists with supervisors and ad agencies. Artists keep 100% of sync fees and PRO royalties.

resources.name: Musicbed
resources.description: Premium placements with brands like Nike, Coca-Cola, Netflix, Adobe. High-quality curated catalog for film and advertising.

resources.name: Marmoset
resources.description: Indie-focused, creative approach. Non-exclusive deals, typically 50/50 split. Has paid $22M+ to artists since 2017.

resources.name: Audio Network
resources.description: One of the largest global sync libraries with 200,000+ tracks. Transparent pricing, broadcast-ready music. International roster.

resources.name: Jingle Punks
resources.description: Award-winning agency with offices in NYC, LA, Toronto, London. 500,000+ song library, 4,000+ artists. Exclusive contracts, 50/50 split.

resources.name: Nightingale Music
resources.description: 30+ years of experience. Custom pricing per project. Strong in Canadian and international productions. Personal support.

resources.name: Pond5
resources.description: One of the largest royalty-free media marketplaces (25M+ stock clips). Artists upload tracks and set their own prices.
resources.cost: Free to upload; Pond5 takes 70% commission

resources.name: Artlist
resources.description: Subscription model for buyers. Curated catalog with high production standards. Popular with content creators and filmmakers.

resources.name: Epidemic Sound
resources.description: Artists receive upfront payments and revenue shares. 50/50 royalty split plus access to $2M annual Soundtrack bonus pool.

resources.name: Jamendo
resources.description: Accessible platform for indie musicians. Free uploads, non-exclusive. Unlimited submissions. YouTube Content ID integration.

resources.name: That Pitch
resources.description: Distributes your tracks to 100+ sync libraries worldwide. Handles metadata and compliance. You keep 100% of earnings.
resources.cost: Free tier (1 library); paid tier for 100+ libraries

resources.name: Ditto Pro (Sync Dashboard)
resources.description: Ditto Pro subscribers access sync briefs across TV, film, and ad campaigns. Ditto reviews tracks and pitches on your behalf.

resources.name: Music Xray
resources.description: Submit songs for professional critique and sync opportunities. Connects directly with opportunity providers.

resources.name: UnitedMasters SELECT
resources.description: SELECT members submit music for sync and brand deals (NBA, ESPN, etc.). Also provides distribution.

resources.name: Millennial Mind Sync — Supervisor Directory
resources.description: 325+ music supervisors indexed with LinkedIn profiles, email contact methods, and project histories. Includes a free pitch email generator tool.

resources.name: SongwriterUniverse — Supervisors Directory
resources.description: Free list of music supervisors in the US, Canada, and UK with company names, addresses, and contact info.

resources.name: Guild of Music Supervisors
resources.description: Non-profit organization for music supervision professionals. Member directory, news, events. Useful for researching who supervises what.

resources.name: Aristake — Sync Agents Guide
resources.description: Free guide listing sync agents and how to get music synced on TV, video games, and films.

resources.name: Musco Sound — Library Submission Guide
resources.description: Free guide with direct links to submit music to various tiers of sync libraries.

resources.name: IMDb / IMDb Pro
resources.description: Look up music supervisors by searching film/TV credits. IMDb Pro provides contact details and project history.

resources.name: The Sync Report
resources.description: 1,000+ music supervisors, music buyers, and ad agency contacts in USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. TV calendar for optimal pitch timing.

resources.name: Music Business Registry — Film & TV Music Guide
resources.description: Industry-standard directory for 30+ years. 8,194+ professional contacts with direct phone/email. Covers supervisors, studios, licensing execs, game companies.

resources.name: Underground Mix — Sync Library Submission List
resources.description: 120+ vetted sync libraries, micro-licensing sites, and music houses. Includes submission checklist and email pitch template. Created by former Extreme Music / Paramount / Sony professionals.

resources.name: Music Supervisors Directory
resources.description: Curated directory of music supervisor contacts in LA, NYC, London, Canada, and Australia. Updated monthly.

resources.name: Sync Music Library Directory
resources.description: Database of ~270 active exclusive libraries and ~40 royalty-free libraries. Designed for producers, artists, and composers.

resources.name: Songtrust — Sync Crash Course
resources.description: Free crash course covering sync licensing fundamentals: deal structures, sync fees, rights, placement types, and royalty collection.

resources.name: The Sync Lab (Aaron Davison)
resources.description: Free 4-hour video course covering how to create sync-ready music, pitch effectively, and land placements. Includes a free licensing directory.

resources.name: Dark Horse Institute — Sync Guide
resources.description: Blog with strategies and tips for getting sync placements as an independent musician.

resources.name: Collabhouse — Demystifying Sync Licensing
resources.description: Guide explaining how sync licensing works as a revenue stream and exposure tool for independent artists.

resources.name: 2Indie — The Sync Society
resources.description: Private music licensing club. Weekly Zoom calls with industry professionals (sync agencies, supervisors, producers). Monthly curated sync sampler sent to agencies.

resources.name: Master Music Licensing (Michael Elsner)
resources.description: 4-step course from an instructor with 2,500+ placements. Includes private mastermind group community.

resources.name: Ari's Take Academy — Advanced Sync Strategies
resources.description: Course on sync licensing including how to get signed to agents. Includes showcases with top-tier sync agencies and direct submission opportunities.

resources.name: Sync My Music
resources.description: Sync licensing course for producers covering creating licensable music, finding libraries, and building income through performance royalties.

resources.name: ThatPitch Blog
resources.description: Extensive articles on sync licensing opportunities, companies, fees, strategies, and trends. Regularly updated.

resources.name: Millennial Mind Sync Blog
resources.description: Articles on sync libraries, music supervisors, submission strategies, and free tools (pitch generator, pricing calculator).

resources.name: Stock Music Musician
resources.description: Blog focused on production music and sync library submissions with reviews and guides.

resources.name: The Sync Report Podcast
resources.description: Podcast connecting songwriters with the sync licensing industry.

resources.name: Lodge Cove Collective
resources.description: Personal accounts and guides on navigating sync licensing as an indie musician.

resources.name: Rareform Audio Blog
resources.description: Articles on how sync licensing empowers independent artists outside traditional label structures.
